prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define the canonical UserModule type set command, input, adapter and view, with non-overlapping responsibilities and no implicit authority transfer between types. [2] Define the four primary UserModule types `command`, `input`, `adapter` and `view`, each with a narrow canonical responsibility and no implicit cross-type authority.

references.purpose: Input type maps to explicit Input semantics.

semantics.adapter_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Adapter type is a symbol mount/translation boundary. [2] Adapter translates/mounts but does not own source/target semantics.
semantics.command_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Command type executes only through Core dispatch. [2] Command type does not become a persistent input source.
semantics.composition_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Combining capabilities uses explicit composition rather than silently widening one module type. [2] Higher-level compositions reference these type semantics instead of weakening their boundaries.
semantics.input_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Input type writes only owned validated data. [2] Input payload remains inert until another explicit operation consumes it.
semantics.single_primary_rule: Every UserModule declares one primary type unless an explicit composition contract permits a multi-surface Meta composition.
semantics.single_primary_type_rule: A module declares one primary runtime type unless an explicit composition contract defines otherwise.

types.adapter: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Mounts/translates symbols only; it is not an independent command authority. [2] mounts/translates symbols/protocol/data shape and has no hidden execution authority
types.command: Reconciled source clauses: [1] One-shot invokable module capability resolved through canonical command/operation dispatch. [2] one-shot explicit operation surface executed through normal dispatch
types.input: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Receives/validates data and writes its owned #UM module surface. [2] acquires/receives data and writes validated inert data into its declared #UM/#INPUT surface
types.view: Reconciled source clauses: [1] UI/read projection only; it owns no backend semantics or write authority. [2] UI/projection only and owns no backend/runtime mutation semantics

semantics.view_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] View type is read-only/projection-only unless it explicitly invokes canonical write operations owned elsewhere. [2] View does not become an execution/backend authority.
